title: Alphabet Tracing Worksheets for Preschool and Kindergarten (A to Z Printables)
description: Printable alphabet tracing worksheets for preschool and kindergarten. One page per letter, A to Z: trace the uppercase and lowercase letter, write your own, circle the letter, and learn two beginning sound pictures. Comes in colour and in black and white.
alt: Printable alphabet tracing worksheets showing the letter A page and the letter C page, with tracing boxes and beginning sound pictures.

title: Number Tracing Worksheets 1 to 20 for Preschool and Kindergarten (Printable)
description: Printable number tracing and counting worksheets for preschool and kindergarten. One page for every number from 1 to 20: a ten frame, things to count, number tracing, writing practice and a missing number row. Comes in colour and in black and white.
alt: Printable number tracing worksheets showing the number 3 page and the number 13 page with ten frames, counting pictures and tracing boxes.

title: Addition Within 10 Worksheets with Pictures for Kindergarten and 1st Grade
description: Printable addition within 10 worksheets for kindergarten and first grade. Ten picture pages where children count two groups, then ten pages of sums with a number line to help, plus an answer key. Comes in colour and in black and white to save ink.
alt: Printable addition worksheets: a page of picture sums with apples and cars, and a page of sums with a zero to ten number line.

title: Letter Tracing Practice for Ages 3 to 6: Uppercase and Lowercase Printable Pages
description: Letter tracing practice pages for children ages 3 to 6. Each printable worksheet has uppercase and lowercase tracing, space to write the letter alone, a find-the-letter row and beginning sound pictures. Great for homeschool, morning work and literacy centres.
alt: A printable letter P tracing worksheet with uppercase and lowercase tracing boxes, a pig and a pizza picture, and a row of letters to circle.

title: Ten Frame Counting and Number Writing Practice for Ages 3 to 6 (Numbers 1 to 20)
description: Number practice pages for children ages 3 to 6. Each printable worksheet shows the number on a ten frame, gives pictures to count, then tracing and writing practice and a missing number line. Useful for homeschool preschool, morning work and maths centres.
alt: A printable number 7 worksheet with a ten frame, seven cookies to count, tracing boxes and a missing number row.

title: Number Line Addition Practice to 10: No Prep Printable Worksheets
description: No prep addition practice for beginners. Children start with picture sums and move on to adding with a number line from 0 to 10. 160 sums in total, with an answer key so a child can check their own work. For kindergarten, first grade and homeschool maths.
alt: A printable addition worksheet with a number line from zero to ten and twelve sums in coloured boxes.

title: Subtraction Within 10 Worksheets with Pictures for Kindergarten and 1st Grade
description: Printable subtraction within 10 worksheets for kindergarten and first grade. Ten cross-out picture pages where children count what is left, then ten pages of take-away sums with a number line, plus an answer key. In colour and in black and white.
alt: Printable subtraction worksheets: a page of cars with some crossed out, and a page of take-away sums with a number line.

title: Beginner Subtraction Practice: Cross Out Pictures and Number Line Worksheets
description: Beginner subtraction practice that makes taking away easy to see. Children cross out pictures and count what is left, then practise hopping back on a number line from 10. 160 sums with an answer key. For kindergarten, first grade and homeschool maths.
alt: A printable subtraction worksheet showing rows of cars with some crossed out and sums such as ten take away seven.
